summary: Phase 3 (PIN + Biometrik) testing completed on mobile viewport 390x844. Backend Phase 1+2 sanity OK (6/6 endpoints 200). Frontend PIN flow had ONE CRITICAL bug (root caused & fixed by testing agent): in setup-pin.tsx, the imported `setPin` from pinService was shadowed by `useState`'s setter, so the PIN hash was NEVER persisted to storage. After the 2-line fix, ALL PIN/lock/edit/disable flows pass: PIN setup → confirm → save → persists → cold-start lock overlay → wrong PIN error → correct PIN unlock → edit mode (back btn + disable link) → disable returns to OFF. Biometrik switch correctly disabled on web (no hardware).

critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: /app/frontend/app/setup-pin.tsx line 9 imported `setPin` from pinService, but line 25 `const [pin, setPin] = useState('')` shadows it. Result: `await setPin(pin)` on line 51 called the React state setter (no-op for storage) and silently succeeded, so PIN was never persisted. Renamed import to `savePin` and call site to `await savePin(pin)`.
AppLockContext correctly bootstraps `locked = isPinSet()` on full page load, so cold-start protection works on web via AsyncStorage/IndexedDB persistence.
LockOverlay correctly hides when !locked || !pinConfigured. Z-index 9999 + absoluteFillObject prevents tap-through.
PIN setup screen's keypad spans 3 columns (76px keys + 14px gap) and meets 44pt min touch-target.
biometricService correctly short-circuits on Platform.OS === 'web' returning {supported:false}. Bio Switch row in pengaturan stays in disabled state with hint 'Tidak didukung perangkat'.
pinService uses SHA-256 with 16-byte random salt — good practice. Storage is AsyncStorage-backed on web (IndexedDB) which persists across reloads.
Forgot-PIN flow correctly calls DataApi.reset() THEN resetPinSecurity() — proper order so backend wipe completes before frontend clears PIN guard.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 PIN flow now works end-to-end. CRITICAL: tests must be run in a single browser context. AsyncStorage on web persists to IndexedDB, so any page.goto() after PIN is set will re-bootstrap AppLockProvider and re-trigger the lock overlay (this IS the cold-start protection working). To test in-app flows after PIN is set, unlock with PIN 1234 first or use SPA navigation via on-screen taps. To re-test from a clean state, clear both localStorage AND IndexedDB (see test scripts in iteration_3 output). Storage keys: 'duitku.pin.hash', 'duitku.pin.salt', 'duitku.biometric.enabled'. The single fix applied was a 2-line rename (`setPin` -> `savePin`) in /app/frontend/app/setup-pin.tsx lines 9 and 51.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: JavaScript variable shadowing. /app/frontend/app/setup-pin.tsx imported `setPin` from pinService at module scope, then redeclared `setPin` as the local React useState setter inside the component. JavaScript resolves `setPin` in the inner scope first, so `await setPin(pin)` invoked the useState setter (synchronous, returns undefined). The `await` on undefined resolved immediately with no error, `bypassLock()` ran and `router.replace('/')` navigated home — giving the visual illusion that the PIN was saved. But `isPinSet()` returned false on next bootstrap because the hash was never written to storage. SYMPTOMS observed during testing: Pengaturan PIN row stuck at 'OFF'/'Belum diatur' after successful setup, LockOverlay never appeared on reload. REPRO STEPS: load app fresh, go Pengaturan -> PIN -> 1234 -> 1234 -> redirected to Beranda -> reopen Pengaturan -> PIN still shows OFF. MITIGATION: Rename either the import or the useState variable to avoid shadowing. Applied minimal fix: `import { setPin as savePin, clearPin } ...` and `await savePin(pin)`.
